Please call or email with any further questions, and check out our updated COVID-19 policies: https://bikesandhikesla.com/covid-update/

On the day of your tour:
PLEASE ARRIVE 15 MINUTES BEFORE YOUR TOUR FOR CHECK-IN. The tour departs promptly at your scheduled time and we can not wait for latecomers as there are other guests joining the experience as well. Phone: +1 323-796-8555.Email info@bikeshikes.com

This is LA, there is ALWAYS traffic, so please plan ahead and arrive early. 

Parking is available at the Greek Theater, and is limited. Please read all signs. If you are not driving, we highly suggest using a ride share service such as Uber or Lyft to transport you to/from the meeting point. 

Guides accept cash or payment apps for gratuity.

WHAT TO BRING:
• Comfortable shirt and shorts/pants
• Jacket, windbreaker, or sweatshirt (check the weather)
• Closed-toe shoes with good treads
• Sunscreen/Sunglasses/Hat
• Don’t forget your camera! Please tag us on Instagram @bikesandhikesla

product.description:
Reach the highest peak in Griffith Park with Bikes and Hikes LA Tours, a TripAdvisor Traveler's Choice!

This popular and family-friendkly 3.5 mile (5.6 km) walk through Griffith Park showcases incredible views for your 2025 vacation.

You'll make multiple stops along the way to the Griffith Observatory to capture the most spectacular Instagram and TikTok photos in LA (and you'll see the Hollywood Sign along the way, too!)

This Hollywood Hills Tour wraps up with an exclusive insider tour of the iconic Griffith Observatory, the most famous filming location in Los Angeles. See a better price on this tour elsewhere? Call us and we'll match it! 

Highlights:
Hollywood Sign
Griffith Park Observatory Insider Tour
Greek Theatre
Mount Hollywood
The Best Views in LA: Downtown, Silver Lake, Century City, and more!
Famous Film Locations
Insider anecdotes and tips from your expert local guide
Picture-perfect Instagram opportunities
…and much more!

additionalInfo.description: Public transportation options are available nearby
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Please arrive 15 minutes early to check in with your guide. There are other guests on the LA tour and we can not wait for latecomers.
We’ll be walking 3.5 miles (5.6 km) along what is widely considered to be an easy to moderate Hollywood Sign hiking trail
If you don't see your preferred time listed, Bikes and Hikes LA offers flexible private and group tour options—reach out to learn more.
Guests joining this tour should be in good health, with a beginner to intermediate fitness expectation on this Los Angeles tour
Guests should not have a fear of heights, and should not be afraid to break a sweat on this Hollywood Hills Tour

Children under 2 years old are free. For this hike tour, children should be 5+ years of age, and able to hike. For guests traveling with younger children/strollers, we recommend our express Hollywood Sign Tour

Guests must provide their own water for this Hollywood Hills tour. We recommend that guests bring 2 bottles of water, and to hydrate before, during, and after the Griffith Observatory Hollywood Sign Hike, especially important in the warm summer months!
Closed-toe shoes are required and layers are recommended
